dispositions.reason: Query intent/check remains serialized, but failure_lock is released before native Popen. A stop cause can be queued and signalling awakened while state.lock remains occupied by creation. Returned helper is memory-registered before any I/O and stop_new_child repeats immediate handle cleanup if stop crossed creation. No claim of a process handle before Popen returns.

Command stop check adopts pending failure under short latch, releases it for Popen, registers returned handle, then checks stop/soft expiry. A late child receives TERM/KILL attempts even if one-shot escalation already completed; crossed-stop path raises rather than continuing normal launch flow. The handle remains in registry for main cleanup and final disposition. Signal success/exit are not inferred from attempts.

Actual state.final_audit_disposition inspects retained Popen handles regardless of birth match. Live means HELD, invalid/failed polling or absent observation means UNKNOWN_HELD, reaped integer status is recorded in history and only that handle registration is retired. Separately bound groups are preserved. Main supplies a fresh query after observer quiescence and refuses any non-CLEAR outcome.

Initial receipt bytes are read once, hashed, parsed and validated. Their hash is included in ACK and retained as accepted_ownership_sha256 under ACK publication locking. Every post-ACK observation reads/hashes bytes before JSON interpretation; mismatch or missing receipt fails closed without rebinding authority to changed PID/group/birth fields.
